name: Mannie Fresh
notes: The producer this archetype was reverse-engineered from, so the model is his *workflow* rather than a record. Four things separate it from the genre it fathered. ⛔ **The widest tempo span in the batch, because he has two benches:** 90–105 straight for the Cash Money material and 80–92 for the slower Big Tymers records, held in one `bpm` block rather than split, because the same hands made both. ⛔ **"The low end is played, not drawn."** He inherited a Moog from his father and used it "specifically for bass lines". So this is the least root-bound bass on the axis — `followRootsProb` 0.5 against the parent's 0.55 and `mystikal`'s 0.4 — with real cell shapes, `anticipationProb` 0.26 and a 19-semitone register, sitting over a `counter_riff` 808 that stays a tuned pedal at `slideProb` 0.05. Two voices, and the played one moves. ⛔ **"Just to have that real drum feel"** — he MIDI'd electronic drum pads to the drum machine, so `quantizeStrength` is 0.84 and `velocityVar` 0.18: this is a *played* programmed kit. Against that, "kits stayed fixed for a decade — treat the kit as a constant, not a variable", so `kit.preview` is pinned. ⛔ **"Signature fills are snare rolls and hi-hat triplets"** — half that vocabulary is triplets, so `hihat.base` weights `8T` top, and `snareRoll` carries the other half. ⚠ **Layered keyboards are three parts, not one:** "lead motif + counter-line + pad", so `melody.densityPerBar` reaches 10, `emptyBarBias` is 0.03, and `countermelody` runs all three styles at up to 0.85 density. `timbreHint` is `warm_keys` because keyboards "punctuat[e] every song". ⚠ **Early sampling was constrained to about four seconds of memory, which forced short one-shot loops** — that is why `melody.phraseBars` keeps 1 live alongside 2 and 4 rather than starting at 2. ⛔ **`arrangement.sectionBars.verse` reaches eight lengths, the most in this batch**, because the defining rule is that beats were written *after* the vocal to match the rapper's rhythm, producing "verses with irregular durations". ⚠ **Confidence is `high` and the research says so** — gear, workflow, fill vocabulary, sample abstinence and the beat-follows-vocal rule are all sourced. The tempo bands themselves are marked **[LOW-CONF on exact bands]** and should be read that way; the key list, every velocity and register bound and the `intervals`/`contour` split are inferred from the lane. ⚠ `snareRoll.pitchWalk` is inherited — the research says what he rolls, never how he pitches it. ⚠ The vocoder and the classical-string overlay have no lanes; they are recorded here rather than faked as numbers. ⚠ **The 1-bar phrase length was removed** (was [2,4,1], now [2,4]). A one-bar phrase looped four times carries less entropy than a four-bar phrase, and it is the countermelody it strangles hardest: a counter answers *inside* the melody’s phrase, so a one-bar shape leaves it nowhere to go. Every worst offender on `counter.rs` carried it. ⛔ The previous session recorded this exact mistake and it arrived again from the other direction — distinctness is combinatorial in the shape LENGTH, not in the option count.
